key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:C886
name: divide_32bit_normalized
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor after shifting both operands so the divisor is normalized, estimating the quotient with a 16-bit division and correcting it. It returns the quotient and remainder packed together in one 64-bit value.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:C918
name: copy_capped_text_and_dispatch
description: Copies up to 79 characters from a string held behind a global pointer into a local buffer and terminates it. It looks up the current task; if a task field is set it writes the buffer and a newline through an output routine and fails, otherwise it passes the buffer to an unnamed routine and returns that routine's success or failure.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:C93A

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:C9A2
name: open_intuition_library_on_demand
description: Opens the intuition library the first time it is needed by storing the returned base in a global slot while that slot is empty. It then passes a stack buffer and fixed numeric arguments to an unnamed routine and returns 0 when that call reports success and -1 otherwise.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:C9EE

description: Returns zero immediately, with no other operations or memory accesses.

description: Looks up a table entry through an unnamed routine and returns -1 when none exists. If the entry's flag bit is clear it releases the linked resource and clears the entry, returning -1 when a status field is set; otherwise it clears the entry and returns 0.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:CA9C
name: lookup_table_slot_by_index
description: Clears a status field, then checks that the index is within the table count and that its slot is in use. An invalid index records an error code of nine and returns zero; a valid one returns the address of the eight-byte table slot.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:CAE4
name: check_break_signal_pending
description: Reads the task's signal mask and tests the two break-signal bits. If either is set it calls an optional stored handler and, when that handler accepts, passes a fixed code to an unnamed routine; it returns the masked bits, or zero when no break is accepted.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:WORLDCUP90:0:CB34
name: invoke_intuition_auto_request
description: Calls the intuition AutoRequest routine through the intuition library base stored in a global slot, passing no arguments of its own.

description: Program entry point that finds the current task, opens the DOS library and saves its standard input and output handles, then opens further libraries and runs an unnamed routine. It closes the libraries it opened on exit and returns the final result of that routine.

description: When its nonzero argument is set, measures a null-terminated string and writes it through the DOS Write routine to the saved output handle, skipping empty strings. It returns the write result, or zero when nothing is written.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:0028

description: Locks a file and examines its information block, then reopens the file and reads from it, comparing the bytes read against an expected length taken from a structure. It closes the file afterwards and returns the register values it was given.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:0108
name: allocate_block_with_size_header
description: Allocates a memory block through the system allocator and, if the allocation succeeds, writes the first argument plus four into the block's first longword. It returns the two register arguments unchanged.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:012A
name: free_block_if_nonnull
description: Frees the memory block at the pointer argument through the system FreeMem routine, doing nothing when the pointer is null. It returns the register values it was given.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:0156
name: terminate_string_at_length
description: When a task field is set, saves the buffer pointer in a global slot and writes a null terminator at the position given by the length argument. Otherwise it returns without changing anything.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:016E
name: parse_next_argument_token
description: Advances a global argument pointer past spaces, then extracts the next token, accepting quoted strings and stopping at a space or comma. It null-terminates the token in place and stores the position after it for the next call.

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:01DC

key: World Cup 90/World Cup 90.adf:show:0:01FA
